clarification: In step 4.1 the compact pairwise-separated configuration sets are used only to select finite perturbations and uniform parameter bounds. The finite product neighborhoods form open subsets of F0^2 and F0^3 containing those compact sets. Parametric transversality is applied on these open smooth configuration neighborhoods, where the total evaluation maps are submersions. It is not applied to a distance level or to a compact set treated as a smooth manifold. Short-pair injectivity excludes coincidences outside the separated sets, so the resulting transverse slice controls every coincidence.
